scope: Safe Rust USF TimeToInt, ColorToDWORD, TranslateMargin and TranslateAlignment algorithms, including the exact cleanup named-color table and raw UTF16 token behavior.

operations.behavior: CString-style raw-unit tokenization skips colon/dot/comma delimiters. A nonempty token advances one unit past its terminator, including embedded NUL; a NUL at the next token start returns an empty token and ends tokenization. Tokens reverse before conversion. More than4 tokens returns -1 without CRT conversion, empty input returns0, first nonconsuming wcstol returns -1 and suppresses earlier-token conversions. Multipliers1/1000/60000/3600000 and sums use explicit wrapping i32 arithmetic.

USF uses a safe copy of all138 cleanup STS.cpp htmlcolors entries. Lookup is exact and case-sensitive on the first-NUL prefix, matching CStringElementTraits hash/compare. Unusual values and misspellings remain: aqua00ff80, fuchsiaff00ee, purple9370db, paleturqoise and comflowerblue. Leading hash signs are removed before native wcstol16; its i32 result is interpreted as u32 bits, then red/blue swap preserves alpha. Unknown names and empty input yield0.

Empty input avoids wcstol. Otherwise native wcstol10 provides the integer; a percent found before the first NUL selects wrapping i32 multiplication by the window dimension followed by signed division by100. Percent signs after a NUL do not select scaling.
The same9 Bottom/Middle/Top Left/Center/Right names request ordered native CompareNoCase calls. The first match yields1..9; no match yields2. No Rust Unicode casing or trimming is substituted.

boundary_review.contract: Input length/shape and writable output preflight precede copying/admission. Raw units are copied into an independent checked scalar session. Request replies validate op and consumed flag; native CRT work runs between admitted calls. Detached snapshots contain copied data and survive session drop. No native pointer is retained; no raw-slice constructor added.
boundary_review.tests: Raw caller-buffer mutation, NUL/surrogate handling, reverse conversion and failure order, overflow folding, percent after NUL, exact named-color quirks, full alpha bits, ordered comparisons, invalid phase/consumed flag/kind/argument, odd byte lengths, BUSY, wrong-kind/stale IDs, output atomicity and detached snapshots.

direct_probe.coverage: Existing1340 document/reload cases and640 full state snapshots retained as a byte-identical prefix. Added64 named literals,138 color names in original/uppercase forms,16x16 time-part pairs with4 separators,256 code-unit injections at2 positions and9 explicit NUL cases. Each input exercises time/color/alignment and margins at8 dimensions including both i32 extremes. Input units, result bits and errno initialized1234 are observed.
direct_probe.method: Actual selected cleanup USF helpers and initialized document observer. Two reference and two candidate executions per Windows architecture; all trace bytes must match pre-port baseline, including errno.

limits: Experimental document-owner path only; no production switch, whole-format/host closure or complete-library claim.

Windows wcstol and CString CompareNoCase remain native scalar services. MSXML construction/load/getters/attribute enumeration and AddStyle/Add remain transitional native adapters; the final endpoint requires audited Rust FFI to Windows and host ABIs.

The Rust color table serves USF only. Other STS/RTS consumers still use native g_colors and remain migration work. The pinned table is read-only in repository use; arbitrary external mutation of the unexported internal global is not claimed.

Finite Windows MSVC14.44 x86/x64, Unicode-build evidence. No claim for allocation/new-handler reentry, injected service faults, locale mutation, arbitrary concurrent edits, uninitialized document fields, non-Unicode builds or non-Windows whole-renderer behavior.

Scalar sessions and snapshots use typed nonreused IDs and nonblocking admission; caller buffer validity remains an audited FFI precondition. Lexical unsafe counts are an inventory, not a soundness proof or migration percentage.

Crashes, hangs and nondeterminism remain unresolved. Earlier USF visibility-control failures and SubViewer missing-style outcomes retain their original evidence and are not relabeled by this increment.
